features.title: pico-idf MCP server (vibe-coding)
features.notes: tools, resources, and prompts for feature matrix, target, build, scaffold

features.title: pidf.py CLI (idf.py analogue)
features.notes: set-target, build, flash, monitor, menuconfig, create-*, vibe, mcp

features.title: Component CMake + idf_component_register
features.notes: Registers components/ plus project main/

features.title: sdkconfig CONFIG_* store
features.notes: No full menuconfig TUI yet; sdkconfig.defaults works

features.title: Error codes
features.notes: ESP_OK / ESP_FAIL / ESP_ERR_* + ESP_ERROR_CHECK

features.title: Logging
features.notes: ESP_LOGx over USB-CDC printf

features.title: FreeRTOS SMP + app_main
features.notes: Dual-core SMP, Pico sync/time interop, app_main task

features.title: Event loop
features.notes: Default loop + handler register; WIFI_EVENT/IP_EVENT ids reserved

features.title: High-resolution timers
features.notes: Map esp_timer_create to alarm pool

features.title: Task + interrupt watchdogs
features.notes: RP2040/RP2350 have a single watchdog; subset only

features.title: Sleep / power management
features.notes: Dormant + CYW43439 power-down; no ESP deep-sleep stub

features.title: POSIX threads
features.notes: Optional; most apps should stay on FreeRTOS tasks

features.title: Heap tracing
features.notes: No multi-capability heaps like ESP32 SPIRAM

features.title: OTA updates
features.notes: Custom layout, not ESP partition CSV

features.title: GPIO
features.notes: PIDF_GPIO_WL_LED=32 is the Pico W onboard LED

features.title: UART
features.notes: 2 UARTs on RP2040/RP2350

features.title: ADC oneshot
features.notes: 3–4 ADC GPIOs depending on chip; no calibration blob

features.title: PWM / LEDC
features.notes: PWM slices, not LEDC timers/channels

features.title: I2S
features.notes: No dedicated I2S block; use pico-extras / PIO

features.title: RMT (WS2812, IR)
features.notes: Emulation, not cycle-identical to ESP RMT

features.title: Motor PWM
features.notes: Subset

features.title: USB device/host
features.notes: stdio USB-CDC is on; full device/host classes planned

features.title: PIO (Pico extension)
features.notes: Pico-only superpower; prefer this when ESP silicon is missing

features.title: Capacitive touch
features.notes: No touch hardware. Use GPIO buttons or an external controller.

features.title: True DAC
features.notes: No analog DAC. PWM + RC or I2C DAC instead.

features.title: TWAI / CAN
features.notes: No CAN controller. Use MCP2515 (SPI) as a planned extra.

features.title: Ethernet MAC
features.notes: No on-chip MAC. Optional W5500 component is planned later.

features.title: Wi-Fi STA/AP
features.notes: Map init/mode/config/start/connect; 802.11n 2.4 GHz only

features.title: ESP-NOW
features.notes: Espressif proprietary MAC. Use UDP, BLE, or raw 802.11 is not available.

features.title: ESP-WIFI-MESH
features.notes: Espressif proprietary. Use MQTT or a userspace mesh.

features.title: SmartConfig / ESP-Touch
features.notes: Replace with softAP + HTTP provisioning (planned).

features.title: Thread / Zigbee / 802.15.4
features.notes: CYW43439 is Wi-Fi/BT only.

features.title: Wi-Fi sniffer / monitor
features.notes: CYW43439 does not expose ESP-style promiscuous mode.

features.title: MQTT client
features.notes: Clean-room or Apache-2.0 coreMQTT; do not copy esp-mqtt blindly

features.title: Bluetooth LE
features.notes: Bluedroid-shaped wrapper over BTstack

features.title: Bluetooth Classic
features.notes: SPP/A2DP subset only

features.title: ESP-BLE-MESH
features.notes: Different mesh stack; do not claim ESP-BLE-MESH compatibility.

features.title: NVS key-value
features.notes: First vibe-coding slice after this foundation

features.title: LittleFS / SPIFFS analogue
features.notes: LittleFS is the Pico-native choice

features.title: Wi-Fi provisioning
features.notes: Not ESP-Touch; documented substitute

features.title: eFuse manager
features.notes: RP2040 has no OTP/eFuse. RP2350 OTP is a later Pico extension.

features.title: ULP coprocessor
features.notes: Use PIO or a FreeRTOS task pinned to core 1.

features.title: Himem / SPIRAM
features.notes: Pico W has no extra PSRAM. Pico 2 W boards may; treat as Pico extension.

features.title: ESP-Claw-shaped runtime (caps, events, memory, local agent)
features.esp_idf: ESP-Claw claw_cap / claw_event_router / claw_memory / claw_core (inspired, not copied)
features.notes: Pico subset: JSON-ish cap calls, RAM notes, keyword agent, USB claw> REPL. Not full ESP-Claw.

features.title: Claw scheduler
features.backend: FreeRTOS software timers posting claw events
features.notes: Periodic jobs only; no cron expressions

features.title: On-device MCP (capabilities as tools)
features.notes: initialize / tools/list / tools/call / ping. Not a full MCP SDK.

features.title: On-device Lua
features.notes: Pico W cannot host ESP-Claw's Lua + driver set. Event rules substitute for now.

features.title: Instant messaging channels
features.notes: Telegram/Feishu/etc. need Wi-Fi. USB REPL is the local stand-in.

features.title: Cloud / HTTP LLM agent path
features.notes: Blocked on wifi + http-client. Local keyword agent works offline.

features.title: Skills / board manager / HTTP settings UI
features.notes: ESP-Claw wants FATFS SYSTEM/DATA partitions; Pico will use LittleFS.
